about.body: Systems Engineer and Frontend Engineer with 2+ years of experience building web applications with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. Specialized in enterprise platforms, financial applications, and e-commerce solutions through scalable frontend architectures, REST API integration, and state management with Redux. I have collaborated with Backend, UX/UI, QA, and DevOps teams to ship maintainable, scalable applications focused on user experience.

experience.title: Recent experience

items.description: Contributed to a financial platform with authentication, digital signature, document management, and REST API integration. Led the frontend of a travel rewards redemption system, defining the architecture with Feature-Sliced Design. Built enterprise applications with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Redux, collaborating with Backend, UX/UI, QA, and DevOps in agile environments using Docker.

Built the company's first e-commerce store from scratch, enabling its first digital sales channel. Delivered a complete shopping experience with predictive search, dynamic filters, a persistent cart, and interactive components. Improved technical SEO on Shopify for organic indexing of products and categories, and designed reusable, fully configurable sections managed from the admin.

Built a headless e-commerce store from scratch with React, TypeScript, Remix, and GraphQL, integrating Shopify through the Storefront API. Implemented authentication, a product catalog with dynamic filters, a persistent cart, wishlist, and checkout. Designed a mobile-first interface with i18n (ES/EN) and multi-currency support (COP/USD/EUR), and optimized performance with SSR, lazy loading, intelligent caching, and Content Security Policy.

Delivered a full-stack web solution for the restaurant: public site, admin panel, database, and deployment infrastructure. The admin panel lets the client manage menu dishes, promotional images, and site content autonomously. Implemented persistence with MySQL, image delivery with Cloudflare Images, and production deployment on a Linux VPS with Nginx.

Designed the architecture of a chatbot for medical appointments: Flask backend with SQLAlchemy and MySQL, TensorFlow/Keras neural networks for intent classification, and NLTK for natural language processing.

formacion.title: Education
formacion.body: Systems Engineering at Universidad Simón Bolívar. During my studies I worked on programming fundamentals, data structures, networks, and relational databases — the foundation to understand how a complete application is connected, from the user interface to server-side logic.

frontend.title: Frontend
frontend.body: My main focus is frontend development. I build web applications with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, using Redux for state management and REST APIs for integration. I specialize in enterprise platforms, financial applications, and e-commerce, with Feature-Sliced Design (FSD) architectures built to scale and stay maintainable.

fullstack.title: Full-stack
fullstack.body: I also cover the full cycle when a project needs it: API integration, MySQL persistence, admin panels, and deployment. I have shipped applications to production on Linux VPS with Nginx, and worked with Docker in agile environments alongside Backend, QA, and DevOps.

experiencia.title: Experience
experiencia.body: I have built real applications in professional settings: a financial platform and a travel rewards redemption system at Silver Holdings S.A.S., Ferretería Rueda's first Shopify e-commerce channel, a headless store with Remix and GraphQL, and a full-stack solution with an admin panel, MySQL, and VPS deployment for Chikos Gourmet.

actualidad.title: Current focus
actualidad.body: I am available for remote, hybrid, or on-site roles, and open to relocating to any city in Colombia. I keep deepening frontend architecture, performance, and scalable digital products with real impact on users and business.
